paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
coupling_convention: canonical g_ae, dimensionless, as plotted on the 'ALP coupling g_ae' axis of Fig. 5 (left)
notes: Paper reports several new 90% C.L. limits from EDELWEISS-III Ge bolometers: (1) solar axion CBRD flux bound g_ae < 1.1e-11 in the massless limit (mass-independent, encoded here as sentinel flat bound since no explicit validity range is stated; roughly valid for m_a << keV solar core temperature); (2) solar 57Fe bound g_ae*g_aN^eff < 3.5e-17; (3) ALP dark-matter absorption limits on g_ae and hidden-photon kinetic mixing kappa over 0.8-500 keV/c^2, but those mass-dependent curves are only shown in Fig. 5 with no numerical table, so they are not extractable here. The extracted data point is the solar axion g_ae bound (no local DM density assumption applies to it; the halo DM absorption search separately assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3). Projections for upgraded detectors down to 150 eV exist but are figure-only. Coupling type is unambiguous for the extracted value, but the paper also constrains DarkPhoton kinetic mixing and g_ae*g_aN, hence moderate confidence. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 52)) | Vision: Traced the solid red EDELWEISS-III 90% C.L. curve in Fig. 5 (left), bounds on galactic ALP DM coupling to electrons from bosonic DM absorption.
